title: ingest: FeesFromTxParts counts a failed Soroban transaction as a classic fee when core runs without EMIT_SOROBAN_TRANSACTION_META_EXT_V1

target.versions_affected: v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255 (the code involved is the same in both; lower bound not established)

severity_basis: FeesFromTxParts decides that a transaction is Soroban from the presence of sorobanMeta; with TransactionMeta v4 stellar-core leaves sorobanMeta out of a failed transaction unless EMIT_SOROBAN_TRANSACTION_META_EXT_V1 is on, which it is not by default, so a failed InvokeHostFunction transaction is counted in ClassicFeesPerOp with its whole fee, resource fee included. A wrong fee statistic for callers whose meta comes from a core with the default config; stellar-rpc enforces the flag and is not affected (the issue states impact low).

entries.expected: a failed Soroban transaction is not counted in ClassicFeesPerOp
entries.observed: Not run by the kit against go-stellar-sdk's fee helpers. By hand on this ledger (stellar-core's 'contract errors cause transaction to fail|err_err', protocol 30, ledger 9: one failed InvokeHostFunction, fee charged 33733, no sorobanMeta): ExtractLedgerTxParts and FeesFromTxParts give ClassicFeesPerOp=[33733] and SorobanInclusionFees=[].

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's standalone program on v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255: a failed InvokeHostFunction with no sorobanMeta gives ClassicFeesPerOp=[33733], while a successful one with sorobanMeta ext v0 is skipped and a failed one with ext v1 gives SorobanInclusionFees=[100]. stellar-core's test ledger 9 of the contract error test gives the same result as the first case.
evidence.expected_basis: stellar-core v30 (TransactionMeta.cpp maybeActivateSorobanMeta) writes sorobanMeta for a failed transaction only with EMIT_SOROBAN_TRANSACTION_META_EXT_V1; the operation result type (InvokeHostFunction, ExtendFootprintTtl or RestoreFootprint) marks a Soroban transaction either way, and the doc comment of ClassicFeesPerOp says it holds every non-Soroban transaction.

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made on v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255 before filing on 2026-11-19: the failed transaction without sorobanMeta is counted as a classic fee of 33733.

queries: stellar/go-stellar-sdk: every issue and pull request since 2026-11-01
stellar/go-stellar-sdk: the branches with commits since 2026-11-01

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/stellar/go-stellar-sdk/issues/6060; this record restates the public issue.
